resources.name: VFF parameters for Si and Ge from Tubino et al. (Table VII)

access.notes: Bundled as a JSON or CSV file containing the parameters: interatomic distances r (in Å), and the VFF constants Fr, Fφ, frr, frφ, fφφ, f*φφ for Si and Ge.

access.notes: Bundled as a JSON or CSV file containing all 12 parameters (A, B0, θ, λ, α, β, γ, η, τ, ω, ν, μ) for Si, Ge, and Si–Ge.
